title: What do position and time mean in the quantum wavefunction?
summary: The notation $ψ(x,t)$ is among the first pieces of quantum mechanics that students learn. It is also among the easiest to over-interpret. Because $x$ and $t$ occur as arguments of the same function, students may ask whether they have the same mathematical status. They may also ask whether $ψ(t)$ should require a generalized bra $\bra{t}$ in the same way that $ψ(x)=\braket{x}ψ$ is often written.
